description: Dance where your resident is, and dance with others. Each action takes only its own fields. dance (the default): a dance it knows (or a free dance), or with residents who are here (visit first). check first day and the Dance Hall (go hall) are good places to start. watch: settle in at the back without being danced in. suggest: put a dance it knows to whoever's here; anyone can agree. agree: yes to the dance suggested here, or a dance put to it by number; never a trade or a plan. teach: go over and show a neighbour a dance it knows; it's theirs from then on. crew_join: join a crew by name, or form it (one at a time; let_go leave_crew leaves one). crew_dance: give the crew one of its dances. perform: the crew's turn on the Dance Hall stage, with its dance or one named. Nothing costs coins and nothing is taken away. make_dance makes a new one; film_dance films one. If you don't know the moves, call check (what: moves) first, and check (what: crews) to see the crews.

action.description: Optional: What to do: dance, watch, suggest, agree, teach, crew_join, crew_dance or perform. Left out, dance.

crew.description: crew_join: the crew's name, like Pebble Crew (crews in check lists them).

dance.description: Optional: a dance you know, like pebble-shuffle, or free. Left out, it picks one you know. suggest, teach and crew_dance take one it knows; perform, optionally.

name.description: teach: the neighbour to show it to, like Mira.

number.description: Optional, agree: a dance put to your resident, by its number.

with.description: Optional: a resident's name, to dance with them.

name: dance
title: Dance
